7263.title: Width measurements trigger unnecessary message-action commits
7263.rootCauseOneLine: Raw ResizeObserver width enters React state for each action bar, scheduling commits even when the visible actions stay unchanged; the timeline also subscribes to an unused width context.

prReviews.topFinding: Addresses the raw-width state and unused list measurement; linked PR code and tests were not executed.

7263.proposedFix: Store only discrete action-fit state and remove the unused timeline width subscription, then profile a live panel toggle. No duplicate fix PR was opened because PR #7262 already links this issue.
7263.caveats: Both clean runs confirm component commit amplification, not live desktop stutter, frame timing, or full-timeline descendant commit counts. The reproduction test and selected exact output are inline in the report.
